hardware: AWS m7g.4xlarge (Graviton3, 16 cores / 64 GB). Gateway-under-test pinned to 4 cores (the comparable basis); mock and load generator on 6 cores each so the mock never bottlenecks the streaming sweep. Ubuntu 24.04. One dedicated box per gateway.

files.agentgateway.txt:
# ── /config.yaml (rendered; loaded via agentgateway -f /config.yaml) ──
llm:
  port: 8080
  models:
  - name: gpt-4o-mini
    provider: openAI
    params:
      model: gpt-4o-mini
      apiKey: "sk-dummy-openai"
      baseUrl: "http://127.0.0.1:8000"
  - name: claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022
    provider: anthropic
    params:
      model: claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022
      apiKey: "sk-ant-dummy"
      baseUrl: "http://127.0.0.1:8000"
  - name: anthropic.claude-3-sonnet-20240229-v1:0
    provider: bedrock
    params:
      model: anthropic.claude-3-sonnet-20240229-v1:0
      awsRegion: us-east-1
      baseUrl: "http://127.0.0.1:8000"

# ── launch env (non-secret; dummy AWS creds for the bedrock provider's SigV4) ──
AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=AKIAMOCKACCESSKEY
AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=mock-secret-access-key
AWS_REGION=us-east-1

matrix.upstream_note: v2: full 6x6. Top-level cells are the openai-egress row for v1 compatibility; the full grid is under upstreams.<egress>.cells keyed by ingress dialect.
matrix.capability_note: advisory context only (probe-first: every cell is probed regardless): agentgateway v1.3.1 (llm: block auto-populates the same path→RouteType ingress classifier, local.rs llm_route_types): Completions/Messages/Responses ingress translate to the openAI/anthropic/bedrock providers' native wire; gemini egress exists only via Google's OpenAI-compat surface (not native generateContent), cohere is absent from the AIProvider enum, and gemini/cohere/bedrock request shapes have no ingress RouteType

memory.protocol: post-6x6, fresh cold restart: 60s COLD idle (measured before the process serves any request) -> fixed load on the peak cell (c=64, payload=4096B, 120s, identical on every gateway) -> 60s recovery
